kenneyZip.note: Kenney serves the zip through a signed link that is minted per visit (GET https://kenney.nl/download-link/<downloadId> with the site's session cookie, returning JSON {url}). There is no stable direct zip URL. scripts/fetch-audio.sh reproduces the site's own download flow and verifies this SHA-256.

notes: Single source of truth for game audio. BGM files are trimmed excerpts of the originals (see 'changes' and 'trim'); SFX files are unmodified Kenney Interface Sounds members. Checksums let scripts/fetch-audio.sh reproduce every file from its original source. No audio in this package is synthesized or generated in code: every file is a real recording from a verified licensed source.
